remarks: First floor unit, garden style, located in one of the best neighborhoods in Mid-Ridges right next door to Ridgeway Center! Walkable to food store, restaurants, and shops. Hardwood floors throughout, new stainless steel appliances (refrigerator, stove/oven, dishwasher), great closet space plus a storage unit and 1 car assigned parking spot right outside the unit. Laundry is common and located in the lower level of building 1. Accessible to highways and public transportation. Freshly painted and ready for new owner!
